data.long_meaning: The name Beera is derived from the Hebrew language, which means 'Bee of God'. In the Bible, bees are often symbolic of hard work and productivity. Named after this powerful and industrious creature, Beera is a strong and spiritual name for a baby boy. The name Beera carries the meaning “Bee of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Beera usually hope their child will grow to embody bee of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Beera total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
